## The shape of a module

Every module is {{< var workshop.lecture_minutes >}} minutes of lecture and {{< var workshop.lab_minutes >}} minutes of lab. The lab follows **Predict → Run → Explain → Check**:

1. Ask participants to predict the output before they run a cell.
2. Run it.
3. Ask someone to explain the result, especially a surprising one.
4. Use the checkpoint cell to confirm.

Each lab has a core path sized for the lab slot and one optional stretch section. If a group runs slow, skip the stretch; nothing later depends on it.

## Before the workshop

- Ask participants to complete [Setup](setup.qmd) the day before.
- Decide whether you will provide API keys or rely on the open-model path. Both work.
- Run every notebook on a fresh Colab runtime the week before. Colab's preinstalled packages change.
